title: chore(config)!: remove the legacy configuration
body:
## Summary
Delete config/legacy.toml and remove its setup instructions from docs/setup.md; config/default.toml remains the documented configuration.

## Testing
Validation plan: inspect the remaining setup instructions and check that config/default.toml is the only documented configuration entrypoint.

## Limitations
No automatic migration is included; scripts referencing the removed file must be updated manually.

## Breaking changes
BREAKING CHANGE: config/legacy.toml is removed; deploy scripts must use config/default.toml.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/setup.md b/docs/setup.md
--- a/docs/setup.md
+++ b/docs/setup.md
@@ -1,4 +1,3 @@
 # Setup
 
-Use config/legacy.toml for older deployments.
-Use config/default.toml for new deployments.
+Use config/default.toml for all deployments.
